s.note: rationed between two of them all night
s.how: Beat 250g soft butter with 100g icing sugar, then mix in 350g plain flour to a soft dough. Press into a lined 20 by 30cm tin, prick all over and score into fingers. Bake at 160C for 25 minutes until pale gold. Cut while warm and wrap in a napkin.
Toss 300g dry-roasted peanuts with 1 tsp brown sugar and 1/2 tsp fine salt. Warm on a tray at 170C for 5 minutes, cool slightly and spoon into small paper packets like the ones on the plane.

m.note: the hotel they're trying to reach
m.how: Toast 80g walnuts. Dice 2 apples and 3 celery sticks and halve 200g grapes. Mix 100g mayonnaise, 2 tbsp crème fraîche and the juice of half a lemon, fold everything through and season. Spoon onto leaves of 1 butter lettuce.

w.how: Crush 200g digestive biscuits with 80g melted butter and press into a 22cm tin. Beat 750g cream cheese with 200g caster sugar, 200g sour cream and 3 eggs until smooth. Pour over and bake in a water bath at 150C for 70 minutes, then cool in the oven and chill overnight. Top with 250g sliced strawberries.

d.how: Freeze four martini glasses for 30 minutes. For each drink, stir 60ml gin with 10ml dry vermouth over plenty of ice for 30 seconds and strain into a frozen glass with a green olive. Makes four with 240ml gin.
